As an eligible designated beneficiary who is not within an exception, Tamsin is subject to the 10-year rule and annual life-expectancy distributions because the owner died before the required beginning date. At age 60 in 2026, the Single Life Expectancy Table factor is 27.1; the initial factor is reduced by one for each year. The 2026 factor is 24.1.
